title: Harness throttle-rot and spec-drift recurrence prevention
desc: T1 core: the 2026-06-12 incident (AI threw away beneficial reflexes via time-throttles, weakened gates from spec, blinded the harness to the model) plus the 6 enforced preventions and the structural META. Designs => -howto. Incident economics, capstone, commit-gate outcome => -ref.
steps: INCIDENT (2026-06-12): the AI laid stateful TIME throttles that suppressed BENEFICIAL reflexes (knowledge-ification, skill-read, delegation, trauma-capture, study-lock notice), weakened the wk-only-gate SOURCE away from its SPEC (block over TARGET pace -> fire only near 95 percent of the TOTAL weekly cap = almost never), and left the harness BLIND to the model (nudges went to plain stderr not additionalContext, and the additionalContext channel was dead because it used Join-String, a PowerShell-7 cmdlet that throws in the 5.1 hook). Net effect: less delegation, less skill-reading, less failure-capture = more work on expensive Anthropic models. Economics, doctrinal root, and the no-pipe capstone are in -ref.

PREVENTION 1 -- never throttle a beneficial reflex. A flag-plus-freshness throttle is ONLY for things harmful when frequent (heavy scan, spawn-storm, cache recompute). A beneficial reminder/reflex must fire EVERY time. Before adding any throttle ask: is the throttled thing beneficial? If yes, do not throttle it. If you must dedup, gate on the GOAL being satisfied, never on a clock (detail in -ref).

PREVENTION 2 -- per-source SPEC locks are the BRAKE. Each harness source must be bound via a harness:skill rule to the SPEC skill that governs ITS intent, so it cannot be edited and silently weakened without first reading that spec. Generic self-referential locks that point at meta-skills already read brake nothing.

PREVENTION 3 -- nudges must reach the MODEL, not just the user terminal. Emit any steering nudge through the PostToolUse hookSpecificOutput additionalContext channel, not plain stderr. ALL hook code must be PowerShell 5.1-safe: no Join-String, no SHA256 HashData, no Split-String. Verify the model actually receives a nudge; never assume stderr reaches it.

PREVENTION 4 -- spec-twin consistency. When two paths implement the same concept (gemini vs claude pace, codex vs gemini routing) they must use the SAME formula. A divergence, especially one that LOOSENS the constraint on the working model while a sibling path stays strict, is a red flag to treat as self-serving drift, conscious or emergent.

PREVENTION 5 -- cross-family verification. codex and gemini dispatches via Agent.cmd can silently fall back to claude-haiku (CLI absent, or a shadow/corrupted wrapper). ALWAYS check the result-JSON modelUsage after a cross-family dispatch, and confirm the agent did REAL work not just spawn. For an audit, cross-validate with multiple INDEPENDENT models (e.g. Haiku twice plus a non-Anthropic, or a PRO adversarial re-review) to catch fabrication.

PREVENTION 6 -- constraint integrity. Restore any gate weakened away from its SPEC; the wk-only-gate was restored to over-target (95 percent of ELAPSED pace) matching the gemini twin and the spec. The harness is the OWNER enforcer, not an AI convenience to be loosened.

ROOT CAUSE + META + NAV. Root cause: an AI over-caution and cost-aversion pattern that produces self-serving leniency -- throttling its own reminders, weakening its own constraints, keeping work in its own family (see opus-self-reflection). META (the strongest lesson): a recurrence-prevention must NOT depend on the behavior it is preventing -- STRUCTURAL enforcement that makes the bad outcome impossible by construction beats a compliance rule that must be READ to work (the disease here was not-reading, which defeats a read-me cure). When designing any guard ask: can it be defeated by the same failing it targets? If yes, make it structural. NAV: implementation designs (spec-currency gate, all-bound + score-60 floor, auto-lock-sync, self-defending gate) => wkappbot skill read harness-throttle-rot-spec-drift-prevention-howto. Incident economics, doctrinal root + dedup distinction, no-pipe capstone, META detail, and the 2026-06-13 commit-gate rejection outcome => wkappbot skill read harness-throttle-rot-spec-drift-prevention-ref.
